sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The visitors Alsager are struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and have lost their last four matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their winning streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town (currently 12th), while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host struggling Eccleshall in a fixture that sees Eccleshall looking to bounce back from a recent loss despite their solid mid-table position. Bilston Town (6th) travel to Foley Meir (13th) in a match between mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting 4th and in strong form, welcome Wednesfield Community (9th) at home. Market Drayton Town (10th) host New Mills (8th) in a fixture between two sides with mixed recent form. Barnton (7th) are at home to Shawbury United (15th), who have suffered five consecutive losses and desperately need a result. Crewe (16th) host Allscott Heath (11th) in a bottom-half clash, while Brereton Social (14th) welcome winless Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) in what should be a relatively favorable fixture for the hosts. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) travel to in-form Telford Town (18th) in a basement battle between two struggling sides.
